subject.title: Add DI composition root and navigation/activation seam for tray view models

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this additive DI and presentation-lifetime boundary now, before any tray page is migrated to use it?
rationale: The patch is intentionally infrastructure-only but declares new authoritative owners in the architecture ledger; correctness tests cannot determine whether this is the desired sequencing and permanent ownership model.

options.title: Adopt the presentation seam
options.body: Accept the App-owned composition root and NavigationScopeManager as the canonical foundation for incremental page view-model migration.

options.title: Defer until a first page migration
options.body: Pause the infrastructure-only change and require the first concrete page conversion to justify and validate the new permanent boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the presentation seam
recommendation.body: Accept the App-owned composition root and NavigationScopeManager as the canonical foundation for incremental page view-model migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review history shows this reviewer defining and re-checking the lifecycle and UI-thread acceptance criteria for the proposed boundary.
